Name: MS in Accounting
Length__c: Full- or part-time; classes as little as one day per week
Ideal_For__c: Bachelor's in business, finance, accounting or science with a basic understanding of accounting rules. Supplements an undergraduate accounting degree toward CPA educational requirements (does not meet CPA requirements alone).
Key_Courses__c: Two tracks: Accounting, Auditing and Advisory, or Accounting Technology Analytics. Concentrations in areas such as Audit Information Technologies or Advisory.

Name: MS in Artificial Intelligence in Business
Ideal_For__c: Bachelor's degree holders from any background, from professionals interested in AI across the enterprise to IT professionals.
Key_Courses__c: Four foundation courses: Artificial Intelligence; Machine Learning for Business; Quantitative Foundations in AI; Law and Ethics of AI. Plus electives, with two optional tracks: Finance Industry and Technical.

Name: MS in Business Analytics
Length__c: As little as 12 months full-time; part-time available
Ideal_For__c: Undergraduate or graduate degree in a quantitative or analytic field such as statistics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, economics or business.
Key_Courses__c: Core courses: Database Management and SQL; Machine Learning for Business; Web Analytics; Cloud Computing for Analytics. Electives include Blockchain Tech and App Dev, Digital Forensics, Computational Finance, Artificial Intelligence and Sports Analytics. Choice of four tracks.

Name: MS in Finance
Ideal_For__c: Bachelor's in business, finance, accounting and/or science with a basic understanding of financial markets and a desire for a finance career. Formerly the MS in Global Finance.
Key_Courses__c: Core in corporate finance and investments. Electives include Financial Modeling and Programming Language (R/Python), Machine Learning in Finance, and Data Mining and Economic Data. Specialized tracks available.

Name: MS in Information Technology
Length__c: As little as 12 months full-time; part-time available
Ideal_For__c: No tech background required; helpful to understand how information systems support organizations.
Key_Courses__c: Core courses: Systems Analysis; Database Management; Project Management; Web Applications Development. Electives include Artificial Intelligence, Blockchain Tech and App Dev, Programming with Python, Mobile E-Commerce and Apps, Data Warehousing, and R Statistical Programming. Choice of four tracks.

Name: MS in Management
Ideal_For__c: Bachelor's in any non-business field (liberal arts, STEM, social sciences) wanting a foundation in management.
Key_Courses__c: Flexible core courses include Financial Fundamentals; Marketing in the Digital Age; Purpose-Driven Marketing; Modern Operations and Supply Chain Management; Managerial Statistics; Business Strategy for the Modern World; Accounting and CSR Reporting Principles; Sustainable Business Masterclass. Includes a global immersion tour.

Name: MS in Marketing Intelligence
Ideal_For__c: Prior experience in marketing, market research or advertising.
Key_Courses__c: Core courses in analytics, marketing and consumer insights, with electives chosen by interest and a strong experiential-learning component.

Name: MS in Media Management
Length__c: One year full-time or two years part-time
Ideal_For__c: Background in communications, media, marketing or entertainment.
Key_Courses__c: Focus areas: innovation, leadership, public relations, marketing, brand strategy, entrepreneurship, social media and product development, with courses taught by media executives.

Name: MS in Quantitative Finance
Ideal_For__c: Undergraduate degree in mathematics, physics, engineering, economics or computer science. 85-90% of graduates find jobs within three months of graduation.
Key_Courses__c: A smaller required core, leaving room for electives in computational finance applications, machine learning, risk and asset management, algorithmic trading, data science and fintech.

Name: Online MS in Finance
Ideal_For__c: All professional backgrounds welcome. Not eligible for an F-1 visa or STEM OPT.
Key_Courses__c: The M.S. in Finance curriculum taught fully online: a core in corporate finance and investments, with electives such as Financial Modeling and Programming Language (R/Python), Machine Learning in Finance, and Data Mining and Economic Data. Terms are split into 7-8 week sessions.

Name: Online MS in Management
Ideal_For__c: Non-business background wanting foundation-level business knowledge, studying online.
Key_Courses__c: The M.S. in Management curriculum taught online in seven-week modules. Flexible core courses include Financial Fundamentals, Marketing in the Digital Age, Modern Operations and Supply Chain Management, Managerial Statistics and Business Strategy for the Modern World.

Name: Online MS in Strategic Marketing Communications
Ideal_For__c: Working professionals with professional experience in media, entertainment, advertising, marketing or public relations.
Key_Courses__c: Topics include Brand Storytelling, Content Marketing, Social Media Marketing, Brand Strategy, Digital Marketing, Crisis Communications, Public Relations and Integrated Marketing, taught in live online classes.

Name: Full-time MBA
Ideal_For__c: Professionals with at least 3-5 years of work experience who want to advance or pivot (finance, technology, management, marketing, accounting). 85% of the Class of 2025 seeking jobs accepted offers within 3 months.
Key_Courses__c: Year 1 core: Economics, Accounting, Finance, Marketing, Management, Statistics, Business Tech and Analytics, Strategy and Ethics, plus a global or US-based applied-learning consulting project. Year 2: internship, flexible core and electives or concentration courses (60 credits).

Name: Professional MBA
Format__c: Part-time evenings (6 p.m.), with online options and weekend intensives
Ideal_For__c: Working professionals who want an MBA while keeping their job.
Key_Courses__c: 45 credits: four required core courses, five flex core courses, a required capstone and five electives, with traditional and emerging concentrations. Optional online bootcamps in Statistics, Economic Analysis and Business Decisions, and Financial Accounting and Reporting Data Analysis.

Name: Executive MBA
Ideal_For__c: Mid-to-senior-level working professionals; includes a one-week international capstone.
Key_Courses__c: A globally focused concentration in Management Systems: Management Development (Leading and Managing People) and Strategy (Creating, Delivering, Sustaining Value). Additional courses in finance and business communication, with experience-based team projects and a global business trip.
